Lightning Talk: A Pragmatic Approach to C++: Designing, Organizing and Writing Maintainable Code - Oleg Rabaev - CppCon 2025
---

In fast-paced environments, programmers must strike a realistic balance between maintaining a high-quality codebase and delivering new functionality quickly. This talk presents a set of practical principles that, when applied with discipline, enable developers to produce code that is readable, maintainable, and well-designed—delivered on time and with no bugs.
